headline: Japan begins phased government AI-agent rollout under a new governance standard
summary: Japan’s Digital Agency announced a prototype parliamentary-answer drafting app on its Government AI platform for a trial during the 222nd extraordinary Diet session, with about 180,000 government employees eligible. The agency says 102 officials from 16 ministries evaluated development and about 80% of survey respondents wanted to use the prototype; the respondent denominator and method are not reported, and stated interest is not evidence of adoption or effectiveness. Officials retain source checking, policy judgment and responsibility for final answers. No measured accuracy, time, cost or safety outcome is reported.
